pixelLab.description: Change this farm into one continuous brown soil bed freshly plowed before planting. Use five perfectly clear horizontal grooves running in unbroken bands edge to edge across a single flat brown soil patch. Loam with subtle scattered clods and dusty ridge highlights. Keep the footprint and pixel scale. High top-down orthographic camera. Opaque brown earth between furrows, transparent outside. Remove all vegetation. Flat ground.
pixelLab.name: Turned loam

composition: Unscaled F3 soil has three horizontal furrows per interior cell. Exterior edges use the original F3 border. Concave corners use the existing wheat join geometry.
